findings.summary: The Q19 initials code is syntactically broken and would not produce the stated result.
findings.evidence: [''.join(w[0]\n   for w in c['name'].split()\n   for c in customers]
findings.fix: Write it as [''.join(w[0] for w in c['name'].split()) for c in customers]. That closes join( and puts the customer loop first, so c is defined before it is used.
